item.title: Deuterium enables chip waveguides to generate broadband light from infrared pulses
item.description: A research team from Singapore, led by Associate Professor Dawn Tan of the Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD) and Dr. Luo Xianshu, head of the Silicon Photonics Department at the A*STAR Institute of Microelectronics (A*STAR IME), has developed a low-loss silicon nitride waveguide that generates broadband light on a chip. item.title: 英特尔代工获微软下一代AI芯片订单，将采用18A工艺
item.description: 据报道，英特尔已获得微软的一笔重要订单。微软或将采用英特尔代工的18A或18A-P工艺为其制造下一代AI处理器。这是英特尔代工在18A节点上首次确认的重大外部客户订单。

item.title: A swept-source dual-comb spectrometer on a chip
item.description: arXiv:2608.22827v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dual-comb spectroscopy (DCS) enables high-speed, high-resolution spectroscopy by down-converting optical spectra to the radio-frequency (RF) domain through the interference of two mutually detuned frequency combs. item.title: 'Rainbow-on-a-chip' could help unlock 6G networks and precision timing for quantum technologies
item.description: Loughborough University physicists and an international team have demonstrated that a grain-of-rice-sized microchip can be used to produce a spectrum of precisely spaced frequencies of light, which is then converted into multiple high-frequency electromagnetic signals known as millimeter waves.
